message: 時間

name: Synn
message: 「Whew~ That was suffocating. Let's head into the library for a change of pace.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you wanna blow off steam, wouldn't the hill be better?」

name: Synn
message: 「I want to soak in some nice quiet.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, with a student teacher like that, I don't blame ya.」
Our student teacher, Ms. Sengen'in, turned out to be unexpectedly strict.
During class, she forbids any private chatter and glares intimidatingly at the students from the podium.
An oppressive silence. There's no real reason to feel down, yet my spirits sink anyway.
It's the same quiet, yet the library's silence is completely different. Here, there's a sense of peace, like resting in the middle of a forest.
Even though the students aren't talking in either place, why does it feel so worlds apart?

name: Synn
message: 「Hello.」
I exchange a silent nod with Ms. Melilot.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you organizing the collection?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Just maintaining the air conditioning.」
Just like creating a comfortable atmosphere for students inside the library, this is a job only Ms. Melilot, the librarian, can do.
Humidity is a book's worst enemy. Ms. Melilot never fails to notice even the slightest trace of dampness that no one else would catch.
Each time, by opening and closing the windows, she handles the fine adjustments that the air conditioner alone can't achieve.
Thanks to that, even in this humid country--and in a seaside town like Ryuusei Town no less--the library's books are kept in ideal condition.
I offered to help her out once before, but I couldn't figure out the knack for how much to open or close them and ended up giving up.

name: Synn
message: 「Merilo--」
A brief exchange and a refreshing quiet.
No need for unnecessary chatter. Move along to the reading tables--Ms. Melilot says as much without a word.

name: Melilot
message: 「Your friend is waiting for you over there.」

name: Synn
message: 「Friend?」
Could it be Misa?

name: Sally
message: 「Nn... nnh? Mmm-mmm...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sally...!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Afuu... nod, nod... w-whoa-whoa-whoa... mhm, mhm...」
Sally is fighting off sleep while reading with all her might.
What she's holding in her hands looks like a picture book at first glance, but looking closer, it's a hardcover children's novel.

name: Sally
message: 「Doze, doze... zzz, mumble, mumble...」

name: Sally
message: 「Gasp! A-A-A-Ah... Mm, I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「...I wonder how old Sally would be in human years?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun. Sally is not human, so that question does not apply.」
Well, I'm a demon too, though.

name: Melilot
message: 「Sally lives by Sally's own time. Isn't that enough?」
She has a point. Unable to say anything, I nod.
Could it be because I'm mentally exhausted from class? I fall under the illusion that the bookshelf behind Melilot-san is literally a part of her body.
It feels as though the time Melilot-san has lived has accumulated into geological strata.

name: Melilot
message: 「In addition... wanting to know a lady's age is quite uncouth.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh... So it's a topic you'd be troubled to have turned on yourself, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san is older than Helena-san, so...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is quite uncouth.」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh! L-Let's drop it, Paqy. No matter how old Melilot-san is, Melilot-san is still Melilot-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee. Well then, please take your time.」
